nodes.title: Help
widgets_values:
## 1 · Plate + settings

Paste the plate path into **i2 Roto · Setup** (video file, frame folder, or `shot.####.exr`). Every setting lives on this node.

- **window**: 1280x704 for 8 GB cards, 1920x1088 is the model's native size.
- **detail**: `native` = sharp native-res edges (slowest), `proxy only` = one pass.
- Check the info box and the first-frame preview before a long run.

widgets_values:
## 2 · Models

Five files:

- `models/diffusion_models/` ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors
- `models/loras/LTX/` ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-alpha-gen-0.9.safetensors (re-pick it in the LoRA node if yours sits elsewhere)
- `models/vae/` ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors
- `models/vae/` ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors
- `models/text_encoders/` gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors

The Alpha Gen LoRA is gated: accept the license at https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-Alpha-Gen first.

No prompt is used. Frame rate conditioning is fixed at 24.

nodes.title: Help
widgets_values:
## 3 · Proxy pass

The whole frame, scaled to fit the window, one chunk per loop iteration. Chunks share one frame; the last matte frame of a chunk is pinned as frame 0 of the next.

Mattes go to a cache on disk, not into RAM.

nodes.title: Help
widgets_values:
## 4 · Detail pass

Plans window-size tiles along the matte's edge band at native (or 2x proxy) resolution and runs only the tile x chunk jobs the edge actually touches.

Zero jobs is normal for `proxy only` or plates that already fit the window.

nodes.title: Help
widgets_values:
## 5 · Output

Blends the tiles into the upscaled proxy inside the edge band and writes the matte sequence at the plate's native resolution, one frame at a time.

The two videos are small QC previews (matte, and plate over a checker).
